profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary: Currently working as a software developer in the defense industry. Completed my computer science bachelor's degrees at Syracuse University.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Developed general purpose code for the company's Oakland project which simulated the scheduling of satellites and their data collection metrics. Worked with Java, Log4j, Python, SQL.

positions.title: Software Quality Assurance Developer
positions.description: Designed and implemented automated testing procedures using Java and Selenium to test how a program would respond to simulated user interactions with the GUI.

positions.title: Technical Intern
positions.description: Researched and implemented various model management methods to streamline company workflow. Used JPL's OpenMBEE library, SysML, Docker, Windows 10, and more. Contributed to the company as well as the open source community with comprehensive documentation detailing set up and usage procedures.

volunteerExperiences.description:
I was a very active member all throughout my high school career and I volunteered for various humanitarian causes such as child literacy, homeless shelters, AIDs awareness, etc.
- Key Club Recognized Good Member in Standing awarded twice.
- Key Club Member of the Month awarded once.
- Key Club Distinguished Member awarded once.
